notes.subject: khen
notes.rationale: חן em i khen (gras bilong bodi / gutpela kain pasin) — mi holim nois bilong Hibru, no tanim long 'marimari'

notes.subject: תמגנך
notes.rationale: מגן: 'em bai i skelim yu / holim yu olsem sanba' (KJV 'deliver') o 'em bai i bagarapim yu' (samtain ol man i ritim hangu); mi go long pasin bilong protèksen

translation: Em bai i givim long het bilong yu wreath bilong khen; kroun bilong glori em bai i pulim yu long seif ples.

tokens.gloss: bai i pulim yu long seif ples
